table_result.name: //bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/royston-dev-8253/datasets/cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy/tables/transactions
table_result.overview: This table stores individual financial transactions. It provides a record of monetary movements associated with accounts. This data supports analysis of spending patterns and financial activity. It is useful for tracking account debits and credits.

fields.name: txn_date
fields.description: This column holds the date when the transaction occurred.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: This column holds the monetary value of the transaction.

fields.name: merchant_category
fields.description: This column holds the category of the merchant involved in the transaction.

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: This column holds a unique identifier for each transaction.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: This column holds the identifier for the account associated with the transaction.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  COVAR_SAMP(t.amount, account_merchant_diversity.distinct_merchants) AS amount_merchant_diversity_covariance
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` AS t
JOIN (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_category) AS distinct_merchants
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
  WHERE
    txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31'
  GROUP BY
    account_id
) AS account_merchant_diversity
ON
  t.account_id = account_merchant_diversity.account_id
WHERE
  t.txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31';
queries.description: Compute the sample covariance between the transaction amount and the number of distinct merchant categories visited by each account, for a given period, to see if accounts with higher spending also explore more merchant types.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  CORR(t.amount, account_txn_counts.num_transactions) AS amount_transaction_count_correlation
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` AS t
JOIN (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(transaction_id) AS num_transactions
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
  WHERE
    txn_date = '2023-01-15'
  GROUP BY
    account_id
) AS account_txn_counts
ON
  t.account_id = account_txn_counts.account_id
WHERE
  t.txn_date = '2023-01-15';
queries.description: Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between transaction amount and the number of transactions per account for a specific date, to understand if higher transaction amounts are associated with more frequent transactions.

queries.sql: SELECT account_id, txn_date, cumulative_amount FROM (SELECT account_id, txn_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS cumulative_amount, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS total_account_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`) WHERE cumulative_amount >= 0.5 * total_account_amount QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) = 1;
queries.description: Calculate the cumulative sum of transaction amounts for each account, ordered by transaction date, and identify the date when 50% of the total amount was reached.

queries.sql: SELECT account_id, STDDEV(daily_total_amount) AS stddev_daily_amount FROM (SELECT account_id, txn_date, SUM(amount) AS daily_total_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY account_id, txn_date) GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY stddev_daily_amount DESC LIMIT 5;
queries.description: Find the top 5 accounts with the highest standard deviation in their daily transaction amounts over the last 30 days.

queries.sql: SELECT account_id, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS transaction_month, COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_category) AS distinct_categories_count FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` GROUP BY account_id, transaction_month HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_category) >= 5;
queries.description: Identify accounts that have made transactions in at least 5 different merchant categories within a single month, and list the count of distinct categories for each.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  AVG(amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
  VAR_SAMP(amount) AS transaction_amount_variance
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
WHERE
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM txn_date) = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) = 2023
GROUP BY
  account_id
ORDER BY
  average_transaction_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;
queries.description: Find the top 5 accounts with the highest average transaction amount, along with the variance of their transaction amounts, for a specific quarter, to identify high-value accounts with potentially volatile spending habits.

queries.sql: SELECT current_year.merchant_category, (current_year.total_amount - previous_year.total_amount) * 100.0 / previous_year.total_amount AS percentage_increase FROM (SELECT merchant_category, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY merchant_category) AS current_year JOIN (SELECT merchant_category, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) - 1 GROUP BY merchant_category) AS previous_year ON current_year.merchant_category = previous_year.merchant_category ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 3;
queries.description: Identify the top 3 merchant categories that have experienced the largest percentage increase in total transaction amount between the current year and the previous year.

queries.sql: SELECT merchant_category, APPROX_QUANTILES(amount, 100)[OFFSET(90)] AS p90_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` AS t2 WHERE t2.merchant_category = `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`.merchant_category) GROUP BY merchant_category;
queries.description: Calculate the 90th percentile of transaction amounts for each merchant category, considering only transactions above the average amount for that category.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  t1.transaction_id,
  t1.amount,
  t1.merchant_category,
  t1.txn_date
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` AS t1
JOIN (
  SELECT
    merchant_category,
    AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
    STDDEV(amount) AS stddev_amount
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
  GROUP BY
    merchant_category
) AS t2
ON t1.merchant_category = t2.merchant_category
WHERE t1.amount > t2.avg_amount + (3 * t2.stddev_amount)
AND t1.txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';
queries.description: Identify transactions where the amount is significantly higher than the average transaction amount for that specific merchant category, indicating potential outlier spending.

queries.sql:
WITH AccountSpending AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    amount
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
  WHERE txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
),
Quartiles AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(amount, 100)[OFFSET(25)] AS q1,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(amount, 100)[OFFSET(75)] AS q3
  FROM AccountSpending
  GROUP BY
    account_id
)
SELECT
  t.transaction_id,
  t.account_id,
  t.amount,
  t.txn_date
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` AS t
JOIN Quartiles AS q
ON t.account_id = q.account_id
WHERE t.amount < (q.q1 - 1.5 * (q.q3 - q.q1))
OR t.amount > (q.q3 + 1.5 * (q.q3 - q.q1))
AND t.txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';
queries.description: Find transactions where the amount is an outlier compared to the typical spending pattern for that specific account, using the interquartile range (IQR) method.

queries.sql: SELECT merchant_category, MAX(amount) AS max_amount, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` GROUP BY merchant_category HAVING MAX(amount) >= 2 * AVG(amount);
queries.description: Identify merchant categories where the maximum transaction amount is at least twice the average transaction amount for that category.

queries.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_weekend_high_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM txn_date) IN (1, 7) AND amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` AS t2 WHERE t2.account_id = `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`.account_id) GROUP BY account_id;
queries.description: Find the average transaction amount for each account, but only for transactions that occurred on weekends and are above the overall average transaction amount for that account.

queries.sql: SELECT account_id, txn_date, AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY;
queries.description: Calculate the moving average of transaction amounts for each account over a 7-day window, considering only transactions within the last 90 days.

queries.sql: SELECT account_id, MAX(DATE_DIFF(txn_date, prev_txn_date, DAY)) AS max_gap_days FROM (SELECT account_id, txn_date, LAG(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS prev_txn_date FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` WHERE txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 YEAR) WHERE prev_txn_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY account_id;
queries.description: Find the maximum gap in days between consecutive transactions for each account, considering only transactions within the last year.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  txn_date,
  amount,
  AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seven_day_rolling_avg_amount
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY account_id, txn_date;
queries.description: Calculate the 7-day rolling average of transaction amounts for each account, highlighting daily spending trends.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  txn_date,
  amount,
  SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS cumulative_amount
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY account_id, txn_date;
queries.description: Analyze the cumulative transaction amount for each account over time, showing their spending progression.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  MIN(txn_date) AS first_transaction_date,
  MAX(txn_date) AS last_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(MAX(txn_date), MIN(txn_date), DAY) AS active_days_duration
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY account_id;
queries.description: Identify the first and last transaction dates for each account and calculate the duration of their activity.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) AS transaction_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date) AS transaction_month,
  merchant_category,
  transaction_id,
  amount,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date), merchant_category ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rank_by_amount
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH)
ORDER BY transaction_year, transaction_month, merchant_category, rank_by_amount;
queries.description: Rank transactions by amount within each merchant category for a specific month, highlighting top spending.

queries.sql: SELECT merchant_category, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS transaction_month, AVG(transactions_per_account) AS avg_transactions_per_account FROM (SELECT merchant_category, txn_date, account_id, COUNT(transaction_id) AS transactions_per_account FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` GROUP BY merchant_category, txn_date, account_id) GROUP BY merchant_category, transaction_month ORDER BY merchant_category, transaction_month;
queries.description: Determine the average number of transactions per account per month for each merchant category.

queries.sql: SELECT merchant_category, CORR(amount, EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM txn_date)) AS amount_dayofweek_correlation FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions` GROUP BY merchant_category;
queries.description: Determine the correlation between the transaction amount and the day of the week for each merchant category.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  merchant_category,
  STDDEV_POP(amount) AS population_stddev_amount
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
WHERE
  txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31'
GROUP BY
  merchant_category
HAVING
  AVG(amount) > 100.0;
queries.description: Determine the population standard deviation of transaction amounts for each merchant category, but only for categories with an average transaction amount greater than a certain threshold, to identify categories with significant variability.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  COUNTIF(has_groceries AND has_restaurants) AS accounts_with_both_categories
FROM (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    LOGICAL_OR(merchant_category = 'Groceries') AS has_groceries,
    LOGICAL_OR(merchant_category = 'Restaurants') AS has_restaurants
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date) = 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) = 2023
  GROUP BY
    account_id
);
queries.description: Calculate the logical AND of whether each account has made transactions in both 'Groceries' and 'Restaurants' categories within a specific month, and then count how many accounts satisfy this condition.

queries.sql:
WITH monthly_category_spend AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    merchant_category,
    SUM(amount) AS total_monthly_amount
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
  WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
lagged_monthly_spend AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    merchant_category,
    total_monthly_amount,
    LAG(total_monthly_amount, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant_category ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_amount
  FROM monthly_category_spend
)
SELECT
  month,
  merchant_category,
  total_monthly_amount,
  previous_month_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN previous_month_amount = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (total_monthly_amount - previous_month_amount) * 100.0 / previous_month_amount
  END AS percentage_change_from_previous_month
FROM lagged_monthly_spend
ORDER BY merchant_category, month;
queries.description: Determine the percentage change in total transaction amount for each merchant category compared to the previous month.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  txn_date,
  COUNT(transaction_id) AS daily_transaction_count
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
GROUP BY
  account_id,
  txn_date
HAVING
  COUNT(transaction_id) > (
    SELECT
      PERCENTILE_CONT(daily_count, 0.99) OVER()
    FROM (
      SELECT
        account_id,
        txn_date,
        COUNT(transaction_id) AS daily_count
      FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.transactions`
      GROUP BY
        account_id,
        txn_date
    )
  )
AND txn_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';
queries.description: Detect accounts with an unusually high number of transactions within a short period (e.g., a single day), which could indicate fraudulent activity or an anomaly.
